restaurantName: The Cadogan Lounge by Benoit Blin
bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2023 - 'Award of Excellence'  Treat yourself to a luxurious Afternoon Tea in The Cadogan Lounge by Benoit Blin. Anticipate the best seasonal fare from the British Isles, expertly crafted into an imaginative offering – all accompanied by delicious teas and indulgent extras courtesy of chef Benoît Blin.  The Cadogan, A Belmond Hotel, is a perfect blend of traditional and contemporary flair. Once the regular haunt of Oscar Wilde, the grand Victorian building has been renovated to create an atmosphere of modern, understated luxury.  Located on Sloane Street, The Cadogan Lounge by Benoit Blin is perfectly situated for the high-end retail of Knightsbridge, the Saatchi Gallery in Chelsea as well as the nearby Victoria & Albert Museum, Science Museum and Natural History Museum.
pageTitle: The Cadogan Lounge by Benoit Blin
